name: Varenykovi Vidlunnya
source:
Varenyk and Volynka are heading to the Flower Mansion to deliver huge jars of jam to Lord Benjamin. On this important task, Varenyk, of course, uses his strange ability: to hear the pain and feelings of other people and animals that echo in him when he touches their head. This may seem very useful, but Volynka knows that his ability has its limits...

[From [url=https://lisadikaprio.itch.io/varenyk-echoes]itch.io[/url]]
